description: A dialog over the main window to add another machine's Baude host process to the mesh, by where ssh goes: the destination alone, as ssh always runs ~/.local/bin/baude-headless there (schema/variables/HOST_COMMAND.json). The host is kept from then on, reached or not.

parts.name: destination field
parts.shows: A text entry about 30 characters wide, focused, with the placeholder "user@host, or an ssh alias". Takes an alias in ~/.ssh/config, a host name or address, or user@host; it must not start with "-".

actions.does: Add is enabled only while the text can be given to ssh as where to go. Enter confirms.

parts.name: Add
parts.shows: "Add" button, the default, suggested style, disabled until the destination is valid.

actions.does: The host is added (by ssh with the destination) and a toast says "Looking for Baude on <destination>"; it then appears in the host picker.
